Provenance of the CT-e test files (namespace http://www.portalfiscal.inf.br/cte, layout 4.00,
validated against PL_CTe_400_NT2026.002_RTC_1.01_corr_2)

All files in this folder were WRITTEN FROM SCRATCH, following the XSDs only
(cteTiposBasico_v4.00.xsd, proc*_v4.00.xsd, cteModalRodoviario_v4.00.xsd,
cteModalRodoviarioOS_v4.00.xsd, xmldsig-core-schema_v1.01.xsd). No content was copied
from any third-party sample (MIT or otherwise). They were generated with a small Python script.

Common properties of all files:
- tpAmb=2 (homologacao), dates 2026-10-01
- Fake parties only: emitter CNPJ 99999999000191, other parties CNPJ 11111111000191,
  IE 999999999999 / 111111111111, names like "REMETENTE TESTE LTDA", streets "RUA DE TESTE",
  vehicle plate AAA0A00, RNTRC 99999999, TAF 999999999999
- Municipality codes are the public IBGE codes of Sao Paulo (3550308) and Campinas (3509502)
- Access keys are synthetic (cUF 35, AAMM 2610, emitter CNPJ, mod, serie, number, tpEmis, cCT)
  with a correct modulo-11 check digit; Id = "CTe" + key; cCT/cDV in ide match the key
- QR code URL uses a placeholder host (homologacao.example.gov.br)
- Dummy enveloped ds:Signature with the fixed ICP-Brasil algorithm URIs, Reference URI="#<Id>",
  dummy DigestValue/SignatureValue/X509Certificate (no real certificate)
- Proc wrappers add a synthetic protCTe/infProt (cStat 100, nProt 1352600000000xx, dummy digVal)

Files:
- cte-rodoviario.xml       CTe (mod 57, tpCTe 0, ICMS00, one referenced NF-e key, infModal/rodo
                           with versaoModal 4.00 - rodo content valid against cteModalRodoviario_v4.00.xsd)
- cte-proc-rodoviario.xml  cteProc = the CTe above + protCTe (TProtCTe)
- cte-os.xml               CTeOS (mod 67, tpServ 6 fretamento, toma, infServico, infModal/rodoOS
                           valid against cteModalRodoviarioOS_v4.00.xsd)
- cte-os-proc.xml          cteOSProc = the CTeOS above + protCTe (TProtCTeOS)
- gtve.xml                 GTVe (mod 64, tpCTe 4, tpServ 9, detGTV with one infEspecie and one vehicle)
- gtve-proc.xml            GTVeProc = the GTVe above + protCTe (TProtGTVe)
- cte-simp.xml             CTeSimp (mod 57, tpCTe 5, two det items each with one NF-e key,
                           infModal/rodo valid against cteModalRodoviario_v4.00.xsd)
- cte-simp-proc.xml        cteSimpProc = the CTeSimp above + protCTe (TProtCTe)
